data.credibility: Management shows mixed reliability. They achieved close to their margin target and missed organic growth slightly, but frequently drop or stop reporting on longer-term strategic guidance such as product revenue share targets and specific FY27 expectations.

lines.line: Promised 21 percent FY26 EBITDA margin; delivered 20.8 percent.
Promised flattish to positive Q3 growth; missed.
Promised 30 percent FY27 product revenue growth; topic dropped.
Promised FY27 EBITDA margin of 20.5 to 21.2 percent; topic dropped.
Promised medium-term EBITDA margin of 22 to 24 percent; on track.
Promised 60 percent product revenue share in 3 years; topic dropped.
